description: This file defines types, functions, and utilities for managing a catalog of known nodes, including their device pairing, approval status, and live session data. It provides mechanisms to create, list, and retrieve node entries with effective data aggregation.

methods.name: uniqueSortedStrings
methods.description: Generates a sorted array of unique, trimmed strings from multiple string arrays or undefined values.

methods.name: buildDevicePairingSource
methods.description: Constructs a KnownNodeDevicePairingSource object from a PairedDevice.

methods.name: buildApprovedNodeSource
methods.description: Constructs a KnownNodeApprovedSource object from a NodePairingPairedNode.

methods.name: buildEffectiveKnownNode
methods.description: Creates an effective NodeListNode by combining live, pairing, and device data.

methods.name: compareKnownNodes
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting NodeListNode objects by connection status and name.

methods.name: createKnownNodeCatalog
methods.description: Creates a catalog of known nodes from provided device, pairing, and live session data.

methods.name: listKnownNodes
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of effective NodeListNode objects from the catalog.

methods.name: getKnownNodeEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific KnownNodeEntry by nodeId from the catalog.

methods.name: getKnownNode
methods.description: Retrieves the effective NodeListNode for a given nodeId from the catalog.
